results.title: Cricket-South Africa's Rabada fastest to 350 wickets as Australia slump to 60-7
results.description: CAPE TOWN, Oct 31 (Reuters) - South Africa's Kagiso Rabada decimated Australia's top order and became the fastest by balls bowled to reach 350 test wickets on Saturday as the tourists slumped to 60 for seven at lunch, chasing 288 to win the decisive third test at Newlands.
